presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No stubble, just hair and expression.
presets.description: Facial hair appears on one avatar in five by default. Switching it off leaves the two things that carry the style: the haircut and the mood.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The skin palette moves with the rest here. A monochrome set with two natural skin tones in it would not read as monochrome at all.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue anywhere on the avatar.
presets.description: For interfaces where color already means something else, or for a print stylesheet. The heavy black linework the style draws with survives the treatment better than most.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: Dark ground, mid hair, pale face. The hair needs its own step here: the style draws it as a flat shape with no outline, so hair the color of the background loses the haircut entirely.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty hair colors instead of primaries.
presets.description: The style ships black, white and three primaries for hair. This trades them for tones that sit quietly next to each other, which suits a dense list where five primaries would fight.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Hair past anything the style ships.
presets.description: The same lever pulled the other way. The background stays pale so the hair is the only loud thing in the frame.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Soft backgrounds, the style's own hair.
presets.description: The three backgrounds the style ships are fully saturated. These six are not, which lets the black linework do the work.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The style is already flat and graphic, so it takes a loud ground without turning to mush.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The hair palette moves to light tones so the silhouette still separates from the background.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the head.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: The head scaled up in the frame.
presets.description: The style leaves a wide margin around the head, which reads as small at avatar sizes. This crops in far enough to matter and still keeps the ears.
